OpenAI introduces Ultrafast, a new mode that makes GPT-5.6 respond faster

OpenAI on Tuesday introduced Ultrafast, a decoding mode that cuts first-token latency by roughly forty percent without changing the model weights, according to engineers who demonstrated it at a briefing in San Francisco on Monday afternoon.

The company said Ultrafast works by speculatively drafting two candidate continuations and keeping only the one that a small verifier model scores higher, a technique researchers have studied for years under the name speculative decoding.
